q: What are Denmark and a number of other countries especially committed to under the Paris Agreement from 2015?

options.t: To reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere
To spend more money on defence
To cooperate on preventing cross-border crime

answerText: To reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere
appeared: It appeared in the June 2022 and May 2024 exams.

da.q: Hvad er Danmark og en række andre lande især forpligtet til ifølge Paris-aftalen fra 2015?
options: At reducere udslippet af drivhusgasser i atmosfæren
At bruge flere penge på forsvaret
At samarbejde om forebyggelse af grænseoverskridende kriminalitet
da.answer: At reducere udslippet af drivhusgasser i atmosfæren

learn.text: A number of international agreements have been entered into, including the so-called Paris Agreement in 2015, which obliges almost all the world's countries to contribute to reducing the global emission of greenhouse gases over the coming decades.

q: What is the Paris Agreement, which the UN adopted in 2015, especially about?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2025 exam.

da.q: Hvad handler Paris-aftalen, som FN vedtog i 2015, især om?

learn.text: Denmark's emissions have fallen about 47 percent since 1990, but Denmark emits only about one thousandth of the world's climate gases. The Paris Agreement dates from 2015.

q: Which type of renewable energy produces the largest share of Denmark's electricity consumption?
appeared: It appeared in the May 2024 exam.

da.q: Hvilken type vedvarende energi producerer den største andel af Danmarks el-forbrug?

learn.text: In 2025 wind turbines produced 52 percent of electricity consumption, making wind energy, vindenergi, Denmark's biggest renewable source of electricity, far ahead of solar energy and wave energy.

q: What was agreed in the Green Tripartite, Den Grønne Trepart, in June 2024?

options.t: That part of Denmark's agricultural land is to be converted to nature
To reduce the quotas for how much may be fished in Danish waters
To raise public support for electric cars

answerText: That part of Denmark's agricultural land is to be converted to nature
appeared: It appeared in the November 2024 and June 2026 exams.

da.q: Hvad blev aftalt i 'Den Grønne Trepart' mellem regeringen, kommunerne og en række erhvervsorganisationer, fagforeninger og miljøorganisationer i juni 2024?
options: At en del af Danmarks landbrugsjord skal omdannes til natur
At reducere kvoterne for, hvor meget der må fiskes i dansk farvand
At forhøje den offentlige støtte til el-biler
da.answer: At en del af Danmarks landbrugsjord skal omdannes til natur

learn.text: In 2024 the Green Tripartite agreed that about 15 percent of agricultural land is to be converted to nature, with low-lying land the priority; low-lying land is seven percent of farmland but half of agriculture's CO2 emission.
